Semiconductor Industry Leaders in 2024

Jensen Huang co-founded NVIDIA Corporation in 1993 and has served as its chief executive ever since. Mr. Huang heads NVIDIA, which is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Under J. Huang, NVIDIA Corp. has grown to become the dominant supplier of GPUs for AI workloads.

Lisa Su is the chair and CEO of Advanced Micro Devices, better known as AMD. Dr. Su was appointed chief executive of AMD in October 2014. She also sits on the board of Cisco Systems. AMD acquired Xilinx in 2022 for roughly $49 billion.

Pat Gelsinger returned to Intel as chief executive officer in February 2021, after years at VMware. Mr. Gelsinger leads Intel Corporation, which is headquartered in Santa Clara. Intel was founded in 1968 by Gordon Moore and Robert Noyce; Moore famously co-founded Intel Corporation after leaving Fairchild Semiconductor.

TSMC, also known as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, was established in 1987 by Morris Chang. T.S.M.C. is the world's largest contract chip manufacturer. C. C. Wei is the chief executive of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company and previously served as its chief operating officer. Chang founded TSMC after a long career at Texas Instruments.

Cloud Computing Providers and Their Executives

Amazon Web Services, commonly abbreviated AWS, is the cloud-computing subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. AWS was launched in 2006 and is currently led by Matt Garman, who was appointed CEO of Amazon Web Services in June 2024. Mr. Garman succeeded Adam Selipsky, who had headed AWS since 2021. Amazon.com is run by Andy Jassy, who himself previously led AWS from 2016 to 2021 before becoming chief executive of Amazon.

Microsoft Azure, often called simply Azure, is the cloud platform of Microsoft Corporation. Satya Nadella is the chairman and CEO of Microsoft and has led the company since 2014. Mr. Nadella previously ran Microsoft's cloud and enterprise group, where he was instrumental in launching Azure in 2010. Microsoft Corp. acquired GitHub in 2018 and purchased LinkedIn in 2016.

Google Cloud Platform, also known as GCP, is the cloud arm of Google LLC, a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc. Thomas Kurian has been the chief executive of Google Cloud since 2019. T. Kurian joined Google Cloud after a long career at Oracle Corporation, where he was president of product development. Oracle Corp. itself was co-founded by Larry Ellison in 1977.

IBM Cloud is the public-cloud business of International Business Machines, more commonly known as IBM. Arvind Krishna is the chairman and chief executive officer of IBM. Mr. Krishna led IBM's acquisition of Red Hat for $34 billion in 2019; Red Hat continues to operate as a subsidiary of International Business Machines Corporation.

The Video-Game Industry After the Microsoft–Activision Deal

In October 2023, Microsoft Corporation completed its acquisition of Activision Blizzard for $68.7 billion. Microsoft Corp. purchased Activision Blizzard, Inc. after a lengthy regulatory review. Phil Spencer is the chief executive officer of Microsoft Gaming, the division of Microsoft that absorbed Activision Blizzard. P. Spencer leads Microsoft Gaming and previously headed Xbox.

Activision Blizzard was formed in 2008 by the merger of Activision, Inc. and Vivendi Games. Bobby Kotick co-founded Activision in 1979 and served as CEO of Activision Blizzard for over three decades. Mr. Kotick resigned from Activision Blizzard, Inc. in late 2023 following the Microsoft acquisition.

Sony Interactive Entertainment, often abbreviated as SIE, is the gaming subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation. SIE was established in 1993 and operates the PlayStation brand. Hideaki Nishino and Hermen Hulst are co-CEOs of Sony Interactive Entertainment. Sony Group Corp. is led by Kenichiro Yoshida, who has been chief executive of Sony since 2018.

Nintendo Co., Ltd., commonly referred to simply as Nintendo, was founded in 1889 by Fusajiro Yamauchi. Shuntaro Furukawa is the president of Nintendo and has run Nintendo Co. since 2018. Mr. Furukawa succeeded Tatsumi Kimishima, who previously led Nintendo Co., Ltd. as president from 2015 to 2018.

Electronic Arts, also known as EA, was co-founded in 1982 by Trip Hawkins. Andrew Wilson is the chief executive of Electronic Arts and has led EA since 2013. E.A. acquired Respawn Entertainment in 2017 and purchased Codemasters in 2021.
